delete.description:
Permanently delete an organization. **Only archived organizations can be deleted.**
**You must cancel all Subscriptions and delete all Tenants within the organization before deleting them.**
Otherwise, payment will continue to be deducted after deletion.
This is a permanent operation and cannot be undone.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid authentication token

post.description:
Archive an organization. This will set the archive_at field, marking the organization as archived.
Archived organizations are excluded from the active organizations list but can be viewed via the archived organizations endpoint.

**Important:** Before archiving, the system will check if the organization has any active Stripe subscriptions.
If active subscriptions are found, the archive operation will be rejected. You must cancel all subscriptions first.

400.description:
Bad request. Possible reasons:
- Organization is already archived
- Organization has active Stripe subscriptions (must cancel all subscriptions first)

delete.description:
Leave the organization. This allows the current authenticated user to remove themselves from the organization.
**Security:** Users can only remove their own membership. The user_sub is automatically extracted from the authentication token.
**Restrictions:**
- Owners cannot leave the organization unless it is archived (archive_at is not null).
- If the organization is archived, owners can leave even if they are the last owner (no need to transfer ownership).
- If the organization is not archived, owners must transfer ownership before leaving (cannot be the last owner).

400.description:
Bad request. Possible reasons:
- Owners cannot leave the organization unless it is archived
- Cannot leave as the last owner (safety check for non-owners)

post.description:
Create a new invitation code for the specified organization.

**Authentication:** User Access Token required.
- User Token: Requires `admin` or `owner` role in the organization

**Note:** The `owner` role cannot be assigned via invitation codes.

Location.description: URL of the created invitation code

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid authentication

get.description:
Retrieve all invitation codes for the specified organization with pagination and status filtering.

**Authentication:** User Access Token required.
- User Token: Requires `admin` or `owner` role in the organization

**Status Filtering:**
- `active`: Active and usable codes (default)
- `expired`: Codes that have passed their expiration date
- `exhausted`: Codes that have reached their usage limit
- `revoked`: Codes that have been deactivated
- `all`: Return all codes regardless of status

Results are sorted by `created_at` descending (newest first).

200.description: List of invitation codes with pagination

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid authentication

get.description:
Retrieve details of a specific invitation code.

**Authentication:** User Access Token required.
- User Token: Requires `admin` or `owner` role in the organization

**Security:** The invitation code must belong to the organization specified in the path parameter.

delete.description:
Revoke/deactivate a specific invitation code. The code cannot be used after revocation.

**Authentication:** User Access Token required.
- User Token: Requires `admin` or `owner` role in the organization

**Security:** The invitation code must belong to the organization specified in the path parameter.

post.description:
User joins an organization using an invitation code.

**Authentication:** User Access Token required.

This endpoint requires a User Access Token to identify the specific user who is joining the organization.

**Business Logic:**
1. Validates the invitation code exists and is active
2. Checks expiration and usage limits
3. Verifies user is not already a member
4. Adds user to organization membership with the target role
5. Atomically increments usage counter

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
API Key authentication using X-API-Key header.
API keys must be prefixed with `sk_live_`.
All API keys are organization-level only.
Include the API key in the X-API-Key header as: `X-API-Key: <api_key>`
Get your API key from the [dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys](https://dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys).

UserAccessToken.description:
User's Access Token authentication using Bearer token.
Include the token in the Authorization header as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
This authentication method is used for API Key management endpoints.
Users must have admin or owner role in the organization to manage API keys.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

code.description:
Machine-readable error code for programmatic error handling.
Common error codes:
- `authentication_required`: Missing or invalid authentication token (401)
- `insufficient_permissions`: User lacks required permissions (403)
- `not_found`: Requested resource not found (404)
- `invalid_request`: Request body validation failed (400)
- `invalid_pagination`: Pagination parameters are invalid (400)
- `create_error`: Failed to create resource (500)
- `update_error`: Failed to update resource (500)
- `delete_error`: Failed to delete resource (500)
- `list_error`: Failed to list resources (500)
- `service_error`: Internal service error (500)

details.description: Additional error details (optional, structure varies by error type)

devices.description:
List of device IDs associated with the card (max 50 per request).
Each device_id must be registered within the organization.
Device IDs must start with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), or underscores (_).

effective_at.description:
Effective time (when the card becomes active).
Must be the current time or a future time.
Default: UTC, recommended to use the format `2025-02-16T12:00:00+01:00` to ensure the correct time zone.
About ISO 8601: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601

invalid_at.description:
Invalidation time (when the card becomes invalid/expires).
Must be the current time or a future time.
Default: UTC, recommended to use the format `2025-02-16T12:00:00+01:00` to ensure the correct time zone.
About ISO 8601: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description:
API Key for authentication. Get your API key from [dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys](https://dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys). 
API keys must be prefixed with `sk_live_`.

AuthorizationHeader.name: Authorization
AuthorizationHeader.description:
User's Access Token for authentication. 
Include the token in the Authorization header as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
This authentication method is used for API Key management endpoints.
Users must have admin or owner role in the organization to manage API keys.

InviteStatusQuery.name: status
InviteStatusQuery.description:
Filter by status: `active`, `expired`, `exhausted`, `revoked`, `all` (default: `active`)
- active: is_active=true AND not expired AND not exhausted
- expired: is_active=true AND expires_at <= now
- exhausted: is_active=true AND max_uses > 0 AND current_uses >= max_uses
- revoked: is_active=false
- all: Return all invites regardless of status

PageQuery.name: page
PageQuery.description:
Page number (starts from 1). 
Pagination is mandatory for list endpoints to prevent performance issues.
Default: 1, Maximum: 1000000

LimitQuery.name: limit
LimitQuery.description:
Number of items per page (1-100). 
Pagination is mandatory for list endpoints to prevent performance issues.
Default: 20, Maximum: 100
